text:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — marketing pushed a May 3 promo. Expect embedding jobs (short, dense) to spike ~2.5x for 6–12 hrs/day for the first week. Need plan for GPU hours and packing so we don't OOM or evict heavy long-chat jobs.

Oliver Park: Copy. Any early numbers? baseline GPU hours / peak?

Mia Chen: Quick numbers from analytics: baseline embeddings ~120 GPU-hrs/day across hosted clusters. 2.5x -> ~300 GPU-hrs/day for embeddings during peak windows. Chat baseline ~80 GPU-hrs/day, could go to ~100–120. So ballpark +200 GPU-hrs/day during peak.

Rajesh Nair: If embeddings are short, we should prefer smaller slice sizes + aggressive coalescing to improve pack density. Proposal: create a transient "embed-burst" pool in us-west1 with prewarmed nodes and an autoscale policy based on queue depth. Evict policy = low-priority models first.

infra-bot: frag_score: 0.42 -> moderate fragmentation, packable. reserved_headroom: 15%. upcoming_maintenance: May 2 03:00-05:00 UTC.

Sara Lopez: +1 to a burst pool but caution on coalescing. Aggressive coalesce can pump tail latency for long-lived chat sessions. Suggest fairness caps: reserve 20% capacity for long-chat class, set min_slices_per_tenant=1, max_slices_for_embedding=3. Also note prewarm cost — need finance OK for ~48 A100-hours prewarm.

Oliver Park: Another option: cross-region overflow into eu-west1 for a few hours to smooth local peak. Adds metric/telemetry egress but reduces reserved capacity spend.

Kyle (oncall): Oncall: :thumbsup: cross-region bursting is fine if routing + failover hooks are enabled. Reminder: customers using VPC peering will need ACL entries updated — I'll open a ticket and send an announcement.

Mia Chen: Plan draft: (1) spin up embed-burst pool in us-west1 (48 GPUs prewarm) for May 3–10 windows, (2) enable smaller-slice packing + coalescing for embed jobs, (3) enforce 20% capacity reservation for long-chat, (4) enable cross-region overflow to eu-west1 as overflow path. I'll put a PR in infra-runbooks and loop in cost-ops for approval. @Rajesh can you draft the scheduler patch? @Kyle please add ACL note. I'll request finance signoff for prewarm budget.

Rajesh Nair: Will take. Drafting scheduler diff now: change default slice_size for embed workload from 2048 -> 1024, set coalesce_window_ms=25, and tag embed tasks with eviction_priority=embed-burst. Also adding a short-lived placement policy that prefers same-node packing for short jobs.

Oliver Park: Quick command to create pool (example):
```
rctl create-pool --name embed-burst --region us-west1 --gpu-type a100 --count 48 --prewarm true --max-scale 160
```

Sara Lopez: Also add a canary: start with 12 GPUs tomorrow 06:00 UTC for 2 hours, monitor tail latencies on chat and embeddings (p95/p99), and frag_score. If tail stays < target, scale to full.

Mia Chen: Sounds good. If no blockers, target rolling canary tomorrow 06:00 UTC with 12-GPU pool. I'll post runbook + budget request in #eng-infra. Thanks all.
